name: Ozelle Raven
source: Calm yet mysterious, that's what might be crossed one's mind when first meet this extraordinary gorgeous lady. Ozelle is very collected, and seems to enjoy toying others around. It might not be easy to get close to her, but once you do, perhaps she would open up to you.
